piece_hexbattlemage_magetable_descriptio: A rune-bound table for crafting and repairing battlemage equipment.
item_hexbattlemage_magicbracer_descripti: A rune-bound bracer worn in its own equipment slot. Projects a Nordic magic ward while blocking. Uses stamina to block and parry.
item_hexbattlemage_wand_meadows_01_descr: A resin-bound branch that channels an apprentice's magic into focused bolts. Most effective at close to medium range.
hexbattlemage_style_applied: Wand appearance applied. No materials consumed.
hexbattlemage_style_next_craft: Appearance selected for your first wand.
hexbattlemage_style_equip_wand: Equip the wand you want to restyle, or select it under Upgrade.
hexbattlemage_unlocks_intro: Discover these resources to unlock mage equipment. Discovered resources stay known even after you use them.
hexbattlemage_wandstats_empty: Latest impact: Not recorded. Fire the wand to record direct or area damage.
hexbattlemage_wandstats_base_note: Current quality damage before skill, attack bonuses, range falloff, and target defenses. If no wand is carried, quality 1 prefab stats are shown.
hexbattlemage_wandstats_impact_note: Latest impact after attack modifiers and range falloff, before target defenses. Area damage replaces direct impact damage; it is not added twice.
item_hexbattlemage_trinket_meadows_01_de: A rune-bound river stone that turns a well-timed defense into power.
hexbattlemage_trinket_default_descriptio: A rune-bound trinket for a battlemage.
se_hexbattlemage_parry_wand_damage_descr: Wand damage increased after a successful parry.
piece_hexbattlemage_runestone_descriptio: A protection rune that enhances the Mage Table.
piece_hexbattlemage_reagentstand_descrip: Meadows reagents prepared for stronger magic.
